title: Ulyana and the Undertow
author: Xanthe Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Eriksen, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
